answer_1.quote: We experiment with multi‑agent synchronous and asynchronous Actor‑Critic (AC) architectures as applied to the problem of MT … our results show improvements in translation quality …

answer_2.quote: We used the standard set of MT evaluation metrics: BLEU and ME‑TEOR, as well as semantic metrics such as Sentence Fluency, Token‑level Semantic Similarity (TLSS) and Sentence‑level Semantic Similarity (SLSS) …

answer_3.quote: Our formulation of the unsupervised reward uses the pre‑trained OpenAI GPT Language Model from Hugging Face … the fluency score is defined as the average log‑likelihood of the generated sequence tokens as defined by a pre‑trained large LM …

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluation on the translations of the OpenSubtitles and IWSLT 2014 test sets … A rank of quality is assigned by the human evaluator (second author) from 1 to 3, allowing ties …
answer_4.guideline: Human raters assign a quality rank (1–3) to each translation, allowing ties; rankings reflect overall translation quality.
